PLAN "Postpartum Nutrition Support - Breastfeeding (12 Weeks)"
TYPE nutrition
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary milk_supply:
    name "Support milk production with adequate energy and fluid intake"
  GOAL secondary recovery:
    name "Support tissue repair and iron replenishment after delivery"
  GOAL tertiary sustainability:
    name "Avoid restrictive dieting while breastfeeding"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Daily Foundations (Weeks 1-12)" (12 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday nutrition daily "Daily targets":
        guidance:
          energy "Eat regularly across the day; roughly 400-500 extra kcal above pre-pregnancy intake while exclusively breastfeeding, adjusted to hunger and weight trend"
          protein "Include a protein source at every meal and snack"
          fluid "Drink to thirst with a glass of water at each feed"
          iron "Include iron-rich foods (lean meat, legumes, leafy greens) with vitamin C sources"
          fats "Include omega-3 sources such as oily fish twice weekly, or as advised by the OB or dietitian"
          avoid "Limit high-mercury fish; avoid alcohol or keep it minimal and timed after feeds"
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday nutrition daily "Daily targets":
        guidance:
          energy "Maintain regular meals and snacks; prioritise convenient whole foods"
          protein "Protein at each meal; add a bedside snack for night feeds"
          fluid "Keep a water bottle within reach during feeds"
          iron "Continue iron-rich foods; review iron status with OB at check-ups"
          caffeine "Keep caffeine moderate, around 200 mg per day or less"
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday nutrition daily "Daily targets":
        guidance:
          energy "Continue regular intake; do not cut calories for weight loss while breastfeeding"
          protein "Protein at each meal and snack"
          fluid "Drink to thirst; increase intake on hot days or during illness"
          bowel "Include fibre from vegetables, fruit, wholegrains, and legumes with adequate fluid"
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday nutrition daily "Daily targets":
        guidance:
          energy "Review energy intake against hunger and baby's growth with the paediatrician or dietitian if concerned"
          protein "Protein at each meal and snack"
          fluid "Drink to thirst"
          supplements "Confirm vitamin D and prenatal or postnatal supplement use with the OB"
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday nutrition daily "Daily targets":
        guidance:
          energy "Keep regular meals; reassess energy needs as solids are introduced to baby later"
          protein "Protein at each meal and snack"
          fluid "Drink to thirst"
          iron "Recheck iron-rich food intake and discuss bloods with OB if fatigued"
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday nutrition daily "Daily targets":
        guidance:
          energy "Use the six-week OB check to review diet and any dietary restrictions"
          protein "Protein at each meal and snack"
          fluid "Drink to thirst"
          review "Adjust plan based on OB guidance and client feedback"
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday nutrition daily "Daily targets":
        guidance:
          energy "Maintain regular intake; any gradual weight change should be slow and not during the early breastfeeding period"
          protein "Protein at each meal and snack"
          fluid "Drink to thirst"
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday nutrition daily "Daily targets":
        guidance:
          energy "Maintain regular intake across the day"
          protein "Protein at each meal and snack"
          fluid "Drink to thirst"
          iron "Continue iron-rich foods"
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday nutrition daily "Daily targets":
        guidance:
          energy "Maintain regular intake; align with training load from the Build phase"
          protein "Protein at each meal and snack; include post-session protein"
          fluid "Drink to thirst, more during training"
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday nutrition daily "Daily targets":
        guidance:
          energy "Maintain regular intake; match intake to energy output"
          protein "Protein at each meal and snack"
          fluid "Drink to thirst, more during training"
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday nutrition daily "Daily targets":
        guidance:
          energy "Maintain regular intake; avoid heavy restriction"
          protein "Protein at each meal and snack"
          fluid "Drink to thirst, more during training"
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday nutrition daily "Daily targets":
        guidance:
          energy "Review progress and plan the next block with the client"
          protein "Protein at each meal and snack"
          fluid "Drink to thirst"
          referral "Refer to a registered dietitian for individual energy and micronutrient targets if needed"
